ci.title: C&I સોલર સિસ્ટમ
ci.desc1: C&I Solar PV systems are designed for commercial and industrial facilities such as factories, cold storages, institutions, and infrastructure assets. These systems typically range from 100 kW to several MW and are deployed to reduce electricity costs, improve energy reliability, and support sustainability goals.
ci.desc2: PAA SOLAR delivers customized C&I solar solutions, including on-grid, hybrid, and battery-integrated systems, supported by smart energy management features such as net metering and policy-linked financial benefits.
ci.sectorsSubtitle: Tailored engineering architectures configured specifically for key commercial and industrial energy usage patterns.
ci.engageSubtitle: End-to-end engineering, regulatory, and construction framework ensuring flawless solar execution.
ci.step1Desc: Detailed 3D shadow analysis, load curve profiling, structural audit, and ROI payback modeling.
ci.step2Desc: Handling DISCOM net-metering approvals, CEIG inspection, CEA safety clearances, and subsidy paperwork.
ci.step3Desc: Procurement of Tier-1 TOPCon panels, smart inverters, mounting structures, and precision installation.
ci.step4Desc: Bi-directional net-meter synchronization, relay testing, and official plant commissioning.
ci.step5Desc: IoT telemetry monitoring, preventive maintenance, thermographic audits, and performance guarantees.
ci.portfolioSubtitle: Selected commercial and industrial solar PV deployments delivered across major industrial hubs in India.
ci.milestoneBanner: 160+ પ્રોજેક્ટ્સ ઇન્સ્ટોલ કરેલા છે અને હાલમાં 2 MW+ ની કુલ ક્ષમતા ધરાવતા પ્રોજેક્ટ્સનું અમલીકરણ કરી રહ્યા છીએ.

ipp.title: IPP મેગાવોટ પાર્ક
ipp.desc1: PAA SOLAR operates as an Independent Power Producer (IPP), developing, owning, and operating power generation assets that deliver dependable electricity and stable long-term returns.
ipp.desc2: Our IPP platform is designed to support utilities, industries, and commercial consumers with efficient, future-ready energy solutions.
ipp.engageSubtitle: Our comprehensive 6-stage operational framework ensuring seamless IPP asset development from land acquisition to 25-year asset management.
ipp.step1Desc: Solar resource assessment, GHI/DNI irradiance mapping, financial yield modelling, and tariff structuring.
ipp.step2Desc: Land acquisition, STU/CTU grid connectivity approvals, CEIG safety permits, and PPA execution.
ipp.step3Desc: Debt/equity syndication, non-recourse project finance, green bonds, and co-investment partnerships.
ipp.step4Desc: Turnkey procurement of Tier-1 TOPCon bifacial modules, 1500V central inverters, and automated tracker structures.
ipp.step5Desc: Switchyard construction, 33kV/132kV pooling sub-stations, transmission line construction, and DISCOM synchronization.
ipp.portfolioSubtitle: Strategic utility-scale solar installations generating clean electricity across key state discom networks.

pmKusum.title: પીએમ કુસુમ યોજના સોલ્યુશન્સ
pmKusum.desc1: PAA SOLAR is proud to partner in the Government of India's flagship PM-KUSUM Scheme (Component A & C) — a mission designed to empower farmers, strengthen rural income streams, and rapidly scale solar generation across the country.
pmKusum.desc2: Under PM-KUSUM, farmers, panchayats, cooperatives, and FPOs can develop solar power plants from 500 kW to 2 MW under Component A & 500 kW to 5 MW under Component C right on their land — turning unproductive space into secure 25-year income assets.
pmKusum.deliverableTitle: What We Deliver Under PM-KUSUM A & C
pmKusum.deliverableSubtitle: Solar power plants on farmers' land (500 kW - 2 MW Component A & 500 kW - 5 MW Component C). PAA SOLAR develops, finances, builds, and operates Renewable Energy Power Plants (REPP) on:
pmKusum.modelSubtitle: Flexible execution models designed for maximum farmer benefit:
pmKusum.modelOption1Desc: Farmers invest themselves and claim full solar generation PPA tariff payouts.
pmKusum.modelOption2Desc: Partner with PAA SOLAR as a developer with shared capital and execution.
pmKusum.modelOption3Desc: Lease land to PAA SOLAR and earn guaranteed, stress-free monthly rental income for 25 years.
pmKusum.revenueSubtitle: Electricity generated is purchased by the local DISCOM at a fixed Feed-in Tariff (FiT).
pmKusum.engageSubtitle: End-to-end 6-stage execution framework from feasibility to 25-year O&M.
pmKusum.step1Desc: Detailed project report, solar resource assessment, and substation capacity mapping.
pmKusum.step2Desc: Boundaries verification, soil testing, and state nodal agency registration.
pmKusum.step3Desc: Bank loan tie-ups, subsidy processing, and equity syndication.
pmKusum.step4Desc: Turnkey engineering, procurement, construction management, and assembly.
pmKusum.step5Desc: 11kV/33kV agricultural substation bay extension and DISCOM commissioning.
pmKusum.step6Desc: 24/7 telemetry monitoring, panel cleaning, preventive upkeep, and revenue assurance.

pmKusumBess.title: Dispatchable Energy Storage & Grid Stability
pmKusumBess.desc1: PAA SOLAR develops and operates Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) that store electricity and dispatch it on demand. BESS improves power reliability, enables efficient energy use, and supports grid stability across utility and commercial applications.
pmKusumBess.desc2: By reducing dependence on diesel-based backup and enabling structured power supply to DISCOMs, BESS creates resilient energy infrastructure with predictable, long-term value.
pmKusumBess.desc3: PAA SOLAR delivers BESS projects through policy-aligned frameworks, supported by government schemes, and managed across the full asset lifecycle.
pmKusumBess.engageSubtitle: End-to-end BESS project delivery from initial feasibility and regulatory coordination to long-term performance management.
pmKusumBess.step1Desc: Load profile auditing, duty-cycle profiling, LiFePO4 chemistry selection, and 500 kWh to 10 MWh+ system sizing.
pmKusumBess.step2Desc: DISCOM interconnection agreements, CEIG safety permits, CEA grid compliance, and government scheme subsidy filings.
pmKusumBess.step3Desc: Tier-1 LFP cell procurement, IP65 liquid-cooled container integration, HVAC climate control, and smart BMS assembly.
pmKusumBess.step4Desc: Sub-10ms islanding transfer validation, bi-directional inverter grid sync, relay testing, and SCADA commissioning.
pmKusumBess.step5Desc: 24/7 remote IoT telemetry monitoring, active cell balancing, thermographic maintenance, and long-term yield management.

pmSsy.title: પીએમ-એસએસવાય (પીએમ શૌર્ય યોજના)
pmSsy.tagline: A Step Towards a Sustainable Energy Future
pmSsy.desc1: The Union Cabinet has officially approved the Pradhan Mantri Surya Sarovar Yojana (PM-SSY) to accelerate the development of Floating Solar Photovoltaic (FPV) projects across India.
pmSsy.desc2: PAA SOLAR delivers complete EPC, floating pontoon mooring, aquatic structural engineering, and regulatory clearance support for power producers, developers, and DISCOMs under PM-SSY.
pmSsy.applicationsTitle: Floating Solar Applications by Water Body
pmSsy.applicationsSubtitle: Deploying clean solar PV over reservoirs, dams, and lakes without land acquisition.
pmSsy.engageSubtitle: Comprehensive turnkey floating solar EPC framework from bathymetric survey to DISCOM synchronization.
pmSsy.step1Desc: Water depth profiling, bathymetric mapping, wind-wave hydrodynamic modeling, and soil anchoring analysis.
pmSsy.step2Desc: HDPE float design, tension-controlled mooring cables, and flexible aquatic expansion joints.
pmSsy.step3Desc: Anti-humidity PID-free TOPCon bifacial modules designed for high-humidity water body microclimates.
pmSsy.step4Desc: Submersible AC/DC cabling, floating transformer platforms, and high-voltage grid interconnection.
pmSsy.step5Desc: 24/7 telemetry monitoring, automated pontoon cleaning, and ₹1 Cr/MW Govt CFA subsidy paperwork.
pmSsy.highlightsSubtitle: Official Union Cabinet benchmarks governing floating solar PV project implementation.
pmSsy.timelineSubtitle: Structured multi-year operational window ensuring long-term financial assistance for developers.

FAQ.subtitle: સોલર ઇન્સ્ટોલેશન, પર્ફોર્મન્સ, મેઇન્ટેનન્સ અને પા સોલરની લાંબા ગાળાની સેવા પ્રતિબદ્ધતાઓ વિશે બધું જાણો.
FAQ.moreQuestionsSub: અમારા EPC સોલર એન્જિનિયરો કસ્ટમ એન્જિનિયરિંગ સાઇઝિંગ અને DISCOM માર્ગદર્શિકા માટે મદદ કરવા તૈયાર છે.
FAQ.q1: સોલર પેનલ કેટલો સમય ચાલે છે?
FAQ.a1: મોટાભાગની સોલર પેનલ્સનું આયુષ્ય 25-30 વર્ષનું હોય છે જે ધીમે ધીમે કાર્યક્ષમતામાં ઘટાડો દર્શાવે છે.
FAQ.q2: સોલર સિસ્ટમ માટે શું જાળવણી જરૂરી છે?
FAQ.a2: નિયમિત સફાઈ, સમયાંતરે તપાસ અને ઇન્વર્ટર ચેક ઉત્તમ પર્ફોર્મન્સ સુનિશ્ચિત કરે છે.
FAQ.q3: શું વાદળછાયા કે વરસાદના દિવસોમાં સોલર કામ કરે છે?
FAQ.a3: હા, સોલર પેનલ્સ વીજળી ઉત્પન્ન કરવાનું ચાલુ રાખે છે, જોકે ઉત્પાદન થોડું ઓછું થાય છે.
FAQ.q4: સોલર ઇન્સ્ટોલેશન માટે કેટલી જગ્યા જરૂરી છે?
FAQ.a4: જગ્યાની જરૂરિયાતો સિસ્ટમ ક્ષમતા, મોડ્યુલ પ્રકાર અને લેઆઉટ પર આધાર રાખે છે.
FAQ.q5: શું સોલર સિસ્ટમ માટે જાળવણી જરૂરી છે?
FAQ.a5: સોલર સિસ્ટમ્સને ન્યૂનતમ જાળવણીની જરૂર હોય છે—ફક્ત સમયાંતરે સફાઈ અને વાર્ષિક નિરીક્ષણ.
FAQ.a6: હા, સોલર વીજળીના બિલમાં મોટો ઘટાડો કરે છે અને આકર્ષક લાંબા ગાળાના વળતર આપે છે.
FAQ.q7: શું પા સોલર વોરંટી અને O&M સપોર્ટ આપે છે?
FAQ.a7: હા, પા સોલર પ્રોડક્ટ વોરંટી, પર્ફોર્મન્સ ગેરંટી અને વ્યાપક O&M સેવાઓ પ્રદાન કરે છે.
